subject: Coordining post-widget demo — consolidate available windows

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@brightleaf.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up after website chat — 30/45 min demo windows?

Hi Jordan — thanks for chatting with our widget just now, really appreciate the quick context. I pulled the notes from the bot: team is evaluating inference latency at scale, interested in private deployment options and predictable throughput for 50–200 RPS.

Quick proposed next steps so we can move to a technical demo:
- 30–45 minute product walk + Q&A (Marissa will run the demo)
- Provide tentative KLIs/throughput numbers and a short doc post-demo

I have two windows over the next few business days that would work on our side (all times in CEST unless you tell me otherwise):
- Tue Apr 18, 09:30–10:00 CEST (30m)
- Wed Apr 19, 14:00–14:45 CEST (45m)

If neither fit, tell us 2 windows that do and we’ll mirror. I attached a short chat-summary so you can confirm the list of topics.

Thanks — Priya

Priya Natarajan
Business Development, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

Also, please include any high-level perf numbers you can share ahead of time so Lina can loop in infra.

Jordan

1) 10m product overview and architecture highlights

Let me know if you want anything else added.
